name: Standards
overview: Scripture reveals that God's standards are rooted in His holy nature and design, as seen in the creation of man in His image (Genesis 1:27) and the clear distinctions He commands, such as those in Leviticus 19:19. These standards call for purity and separation from mixing what God has ordained to be distinct. Furthermore, God's standards extend to worship and allegiance, emphasizing that one cannot serve both God and worldly masters (Matthew 6:24) and must worship Him in spirit and truth (John 4:24). The lifting of a divine standard by the Spirit of the Lord (Isaiah 59:19) signifies God's active defense of His holiness against opposition, while believers are called to live separated unto the gospel (Romans 1:1), upholding these divine principles in all areas of life.
